Model-Specific Construction

Superior Standard Features

Thoughtful structural details begin below the floor and continue through the roof. Each building is planned for its size, configuration and property conditions.

▰

Foundation support

Pressure-treated 4×6 beams supported on solid 16×16×4-inch concrete pads, with size-specific support layout.

▤

Stronger floors

2×6 pressure-treated joists at 16 inches on center with ¾-inch pressure-treated plywood floor decking.

▥

Quality wall framing

2×4 kiln-dried wall studs at 16 inches on center, with openings planned for your chosen doors and windows.

⌂

Low-profile roof

Engineered 2/12 single-slope roof with ½-inch CDX sheathing and manufacturer-approved low-slope shingle installation.

▣

Craftsman access

Site-built 60×80-inch double wood doors with black hardware and a keyed lock on the Standard model.

▧

Everyday daylight

Two 24×30-inch single-hung windows, with screens, locks and installation-compatible flashing.

▱

Real cedar details

1×4 cedar trim at doors and windows and 1×6 cedar fascia, with finishing options to suit your exterior.

◆

Built on your site

Every Urban Studio is constructed at your property; building dimensions, anchorage and site preparations are reviewed beforehand.

Helpful answers

Urban Studio FAQs.

Is the Urban Studio built on my property?

Yes. Every Appalachian Sheds building is built on site. We review property access, building location, foundation support and site conditions before construction.

What is included in the Standard Urban Studio price?

Standard pricing covers the exterior weather-tight shell with the selected siding, the approved structural framing and roof assembly, Craftsman double doors, two standard single-hung windows, and standard exterior trim. Interior wall and ceiling finishes, electrical systems, insulation, workbenches and storage shelving are not included.

What is different about the Architectural Package?

The Architectural Package adds divided-light French doors, larger front windows, a secondary side double-door entrance, and enhanced exterior detailing. The availability and arrangement of openings vary by size and require a written proposal.

Can I choose other sizes or change the layout?

Yes. The featured table presents six popular sizes for easy comparison. Additional dimensions, door placements and other enhancements can be discussed during property planning and priced in a written proposal.

Is the interior finished?

No. Standard Urban Studios are exterior weather-tight shells with unfinished exposed framing. Interior finishing can be discussed as a separate optional scope.

Does the exterior need to be painted or stained?

Yes, where required by the selected exterior materials. Required caulking, sealing and painting or staining must be completed within 30 days after construction. Appalachian Sheds offers optional complete exterior painting services. Vinyl and other selected materials have different finish requirements that will be described in your proposal.

Can architectural asphalt shingles be used on the 2/12 roof?

Yes, where the selected shingle manufacturer allows installation at 2/12. Our roofing specification uses a manufacturer-approved low-slope underlayment and roof assembly, subject to engineering and applicable local requirements.

Are permits or unusual site preparation included?

Permit requirements and site conditions vary across the Greater Cincinnati Tri-State area. Foundation leveling up to six inches out of level is included in the standard approach; additional leveling or site preparation, when necessary, is quoted in writing.

Before your build

Know what's included.

The Urban Studio is built as an exterior weather-tight shell—not a completed interior room. Your proposal will identify the selected siding, doors, windows, optional architectural enhancements and any additional site requirements.

Exterior care: Required caulking, sealing, painting or staining must be completed within 30 days after construction for materials that require field finishing. Ask about our optional complete painting service.
